verses.text: The DOMNUL a vorbit lui Moise and Aaron in the țară of Egipt, saying,
This month shall be to you the beginning of months. It shall be the first month of the year to you. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Speak to all the congregation of Israel, saying, ‘On the tenth day of this month, they shall take to them every man a lamb, according to their fathers’ houses, a lamb for a household; (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

and if the household is too little for a lamb, then he and his neighbor next to his house shall take one according to the number of the souls. You shall make your count for the lamb according to what everyone can eat. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Your lamb shall be without defect, a male a year old. You shall take it from the sheep or from the să pleceats.
You shall keep it until the fourteenth day of the same month; and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it at evening. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
They shall take some of the blood, and put it on the two door posts and on the lintel, on the houses in which they shall eat it. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
They shall eat the meat in that night, roasted with fire, with unleavened bread. They shall eat it with bitter herbs. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Don’t eat it raw, nor boiled at all with water, but roasted with fire; with its head, its legs and its inner parts. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall let nothing of it remain until the morning; but that which remains of it until the morning you shall burn with fire. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
This is how you shall eat it: with your belt on your waist, your sandals on your feet, and your staff in your mână; and you shall eat it in haste: it is the DOMNUL’s Passover.

For I will să plece through the țară of Egipt in that night, and will strike all the firstborn in the țară of Egipt, both man and animal. I will execute judgments against all the să pleceds of Egipt. Eu sunt the DOMNUL.
The blood shall be to you for a token on the houses where you are. When I see the blood, I will pass over you, and no plague will be on you to destroy you when I strike the țară of Egipt.

This day shall be a memorial for you. You shall keep it as a feast to the DOMNUL. You shall keep it as a feast throughout your generations by an ordinance forever. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

‘Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread; even the first day you shall put away yeast out of your houses, for whoever eats leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Israel. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

In the first day there shall be to you a holy convocation, and in the seventh day a holy convocation; no kind of work shall be done in them, except that which every man must eat, only that may be done by you. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread; for in this same day I have brought your armies out of the țară of Egipt. Therefore you shall observe this day throughout your generations by an ordinance forever.
In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, you shall eat unleavened bread, until the twenty first day of the month at evening. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

There shall be no yeast found in your houses for seven days, for whoever eats that which is leavened, that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he is a foreigner, or one who is born in the țară.
You shall eat nothing leavened. In all your habitations you shall eat unleavened bread.’  (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Then Moise called for all the elders of Israel, and i-a zis lui them, Draw out, and take lambs according to your families, and kill the Passover. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

You shall take a bunch of hyssop, and dip it in the blood that is in the basin, and strike the lintel and the two door posts with the blood that is in the basin. None of you shall să plece out of the door of his house until the morning.

For the DOMNUL will pass through to strike the Egiptians; and when he sees the blood on the lintel, and on the two door posts, the DOMNUL will pass over the door, and will not allow the destroyer to come in to your houses to strike you. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall observe this thing for an ordinance to you and to your sons forever. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
It shall happen when you have come to the țară which the DOMNUL will give you, as he has promised, that you shall keep this service.
It will happen, when your children ask you, ‘What do you mean by this service?’ (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

that you shall say, ‘It is the sacrifice of the DOMNUL’s Passover, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egipt, when he struck the Egiptians, and spared our houses.’  The people bowed their heads and worshiped. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The children of Israel went and did so; as the DOMNUL had commanded Moise and Aaron, so they did. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

At midnight, the DOMNUL struck all the firstborn in the țară of Egipt, from the firstborn of Faraon who sat on his throne to the firstborn of the captive who was in the dungeon, and all the firstborn of livestock.

Faraon rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egiptians; and there was a great cry in Egipt, for there was not a house where there was not one dead. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He called for Moise and Aaron by night, and a zis, Rise up, get out from among poporul Meu, both you and the children of Israel; and să plece, serve the DOMNUL, as you have a zis!
Take both your flocks and your herds, as you have a zis, and be să plecene; and bless me also!
The Egiptians were urgent with the people, to send them out of the țară in haste, for they a zis, We are all dead men.
The people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneading troughs being bound up in their clothes on their shoulders. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The children of Israel did according to the word of Moise; and they asked of the Egiptians jewels of silver, and jewels of să pleceld, and clothing.
The DOMNUL gave the people favor in the sight of the Egiptians, so that they let them have what they asked. They plundered the Egiptians. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The children of Israel traveled from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot who were men, in addition to children. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
A mixed multitude went up also with them, with flocks, herds, and even very much livestock. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

They baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought out of Egipt; for it wasn’t leavened, because they were thrust out of Egipt, and couldn’t wait, and they had not prepared any food for themselves. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Now the time that the children of Israel lived in Egipt was four hundred thirty years. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
At the end of four hundred thirty years, to the day, all of the DOMNUL’s armies went out from the țară of Egipt.

It is a night to be much observed to the DOMNUL for bringing them out from the țară of Egipt. This is that night of the DOMNUL, to be much observed by all the children of Israel throughout their generations.
The DOMNUL i-a zis lui Moise and Aaron, This is the ordinance of the Passover. No foreigner shall eat of it, (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
but every man’s servant who is bought for money, when you have circumcised him, then shall he eat of it. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
A foreigner and a hired servant shall not eat of it. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
It must be eaten in one house. You shall not carry any of the meat outside of the house. Do not break any of its bones. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
All the congregation of Israel shall keep it. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

When a stranger lives as a foreigner with you, and would like to keep the Passover to the DOMNUL, let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it. He shall be as one who is born in the țară; but no uncircumcised person shall eat of it.
One law shall be to him who is born at home, and to the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
All the children of Israel did so. As the DOMNUL commanded Moise and Aaron, so they did. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
That same day, the DOMNUL brought the children of Israel out of the țară of Egipt by their armies.

editorialNotes.resolutionReason: Varianta textuală din Masoretic menționează 430 de ani în Egipt; Septuaginta și Pentateuhul Samaritan adaugă și țara Canaan.
